description: A plane inclined 26.57° (z = 0.5 x), one 40 mm triangle.

tolerance.note: Z: the CL height at each sample must agree within 0.001 mm (a per-facet approximation must not hide behind the grid); XY: sample positions are the fixture grid, one cell is the placement tolerance. Tightened after B found dropCutterHeight reading 0.007-0.09 mm low on large facets.

provenance.kiriMotoNote: Kiri:Moto (MIT) is the port source for the engine (#957/#959); its CAM output on these meshes is stored in the `kiriMoto` slot of each fixture when the port lands. It has no drop-cutter entry point and its raster topography needs the full browser app, so no headless numbers were invented here.
